name: @capacitor/core
description: Capacitor: Cross-platform apps with JavaScript and the web
author: Ionic Team <hi@ionic.io> (https://ionic.io)

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run docgen && pnpm run transpile && pnpm run rollup && pnpm run build:nativebridge
scripts.build:nativebridge: rimraf build/native-bridge.js && tsc native-bridge.ts --target es2017 --moduleResolution node --outDir build --lib dom,dom.iterable,es2017 --skipLibCheck true && rollup --config rollup.bridge.config.mjs
scripts.docgen: docgen --api CapacitorCookiesPlugin --output-readme cookies.md && docgen --api CapacitorHttpPlugin --output-readme http.md && docgen --api SystemBarsPlugin --output-readme system-bars.md
